### Washington Trust Bancorp, Inc. Announces Quarterly Dividend


September 17, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s202.q4cdn.com/917433312/files/doc_news/Washington-Trust-Bancorp-Inc--Announces-Quarterly-Dividend-5cca25565-2026.pdf)


WESTERLY, R.I.


, Sept. 17, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- The Board of Directors of[Washington Trust Bancorp, Inc.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776953-1&h=3209467293&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.washtrust.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&a=Washington+Trust+Bancorp%2C+Inc.) , (Nasdaq:WASH), today declared a quarterly dividend of 56 cents per share **for the quarter ending September 30, 2026** . The dividend will be paid October 9, 2026 to shareholders of record on October 1, 2026.


**ABOUT WASHINGTON TRUST BANCORP, INC.**[Washington Trust Bancorp, Inc.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776953-1&h=1352687750&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4448288-1%26h%3D212762632%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fir.washtrust.com%252F%26a%3DWashington%2BTrust%2BBancorp%252C%2BInc.&a=Washington+Trust+Bancorp%2C+Inc.) ("the Corporation), Nasdaq: WASH, is the publicly-owned holding company of The Washington Trust Company ("Washington Trust", "the Bank"), with $6.5 billion in assets as of June 30, 2026. Founded in 1800,[Washington Trust](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776953-1&h=2645215752&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4448288-1%26h%3D3994564929%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.washtrust.com%252F%26a%3DWashington%2BTrust&a=Washington+Trust) is recognized as the oldest community bank in the nation, the largest state-chartered bank headquartered in Rhode Island and one of New England's premier financial services companies. In 2025, Washington Trust reached a milestone of 225 years in operation, marking its commitment to helping the people, businesses, and organizations of New England improve their financial lives. The Bank offers a wide range of[commercial banking](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776953-1&h=3662947585&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4448288-1%26h%3D798791277%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.washtrust.com%252Fcommercial%26a%3Dcommercial%2Bbanking&a=commercial+banking) ,[mortgage banking](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776953-1&h=3705731726&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4448288-1%26h%3D3091702457%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.washtrust.com%252Fmortgages%26a%3Dmortgage%2Bbanking&a=mortgage+banking) ,[personal banking](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776953-1&h=385427559&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4448288-1%26h%3D1701539533%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.washtrust.com%252Fpersonal%26a%3Dpersonal%2Bbanking&a=personal+banking) and[wealth management](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776953-1&h=3273489546&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4448288-1%26h%3D1701748921%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.washtrustwealth.com%252F%26a%3Dwealth%2Bmanagement&a=wealth+management) services through its offices in Rhode Island, Connecticut and Massachusetts and a full suite of convenient digital tools. Washington Trust is a member of the FDIC and an equal housing lender. For more information, visit the Corporation's website at[ir.washtrust.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776953-1&h=1292411874&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4448288-1%26h%3D4166715763%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fir.washtrust.com%252F%26a%3Dir.washtrust.com&a=ir.washtrust.com) , or the Bank's website at[www.washtrust.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776953-1&h=1655898017&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4448288-1%26h%3D2117168688%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.washtrust.com%252F%26a%3Dwww.washtrust.com&a=www.washtrust.com) .
